marker.step_source:
import os
import subprocess
import sys

from sase.vcs_provider import get_vcs_provider

checkout_target = {{ setup.checkout_target | tojson }}
project_name = {{ setup.project_name | tojson }}
gh_ref = {{ gh_ref | tojson }}

provider = get_vcs_provider(os.getcwd())

# Checkout the PR branch so that subsequent diffs are relative to the
# PR tip rather than the default branch. Try checkout_target first
# (works for default-branch refs like origin/main), then fall back to
# Patch name -> branch name conversion.
is_patch = checkout_target == f"origin/{gh_ref}"
ok, err = provider.checkout(checkout_target, os.getcwd())
if not ok:
    if is_patch:
        # Patch ref — resolve name to branch name
        resolved = provider.resolve_revision(
            gh_ref, project_name, os.getcwd()
        )
        ok, err = provider.checkout(resolved, os.getcwd())
    else:
        # Project/repo ref — try common default branch names
        for fallback in ["master", "main"]:
            ok, err = provider.checkout(fallback, os.getcwd())
            if ok:
                break
    if not ok:
        print(
            f"Warning: checkout failed: {err}",
            file=sys.stderr,
        )

# Sync with remote after checkout
subprocess.run(
    ["git", "pull", "--rebase", "--quiet"],
    capture_output=True,
    text=True,
    check=False,
)

# Record HEAD for the diff step
result = subprocess.run(
    ["git", "rev-parse", "HEAD"],
    capture_output=True,
    text=True,
    check=False,
)
head = result.stdout.strip() if result.returncode == 0 else ""
print(f"head_before={head}")
print("success=true")

output.meta_commit_message: perf(bead): read stranded report from single slim snapshot

marker.step_source:
head_before="{{ checkout.head_before }}"
if [ -z "$head_before" ]; then
  exit 0
fi
head_now=$(git rev-parse HEAD)
diff_dir="${SASE_TMPDIR:-${SASE_HOME:-$HOME/.sase}/tmp}/gh-diffs"
mkdir -p "$diff_dir"
diff_file=$(mktemp "$diff_dir/sase-gh-XXXXXX.diff")
if [ "$head_now" != "$head_before" ]; then
  # Commits were made — show only the last commit's diff
  git diff HEAD~1 HEAD > "$diff_file" 2>/dev/null
  commit_msg=$(git log -1 --format='%s' HEAD)
  echo "meta_commit_message=$commit_msg"
else
  # No commits — show uncommitted changes
  git diff HEAD > "$diff_file" 2>/dev/null
  git ls-files --others --exclude-standard -z 2>/dev/null \
    | while IFS= read -r -d '' f; do
        git diff --no-index /dev/null "$f" 2>/dev/null
      done >> "$diff_file"
fi
if [ -s "$diff_file" ]; then
  echo "diff_path=$diff_file"
else
  rm -f "$diff_file"
fi

# Stash any uncommitted changes (including untracked files)
if ! git diff --quiet HEAD 2>/dev/null || [ -n "$(git ls-files --others --exclude-standard)" ]; then
  git stash push --include-untracked -m "gh-workflow-$(date +%s)" --quiet
  echo "stashed=true"
else
  echo "stashed=false"
fi
git fetch origin --quiet 2>&1 || true
git pull --rebase --quiet 2>/dev/null || true
echo "success=true"

from sase_github.scripts.gh_setup import main
main(
    gh_ref={{ gh_ref | tojson }},
    n={{ n | tojson }},
    release={{ release | tojson }},
    workflow_label={{ workflow_label | tojson }},
)

Bead `sase-1t3.11.1.5` is done and closed.

**What changed:** `load_stranded_report` now collects facts and titles from one slim Rust snapshot (`bead_stranded_snapshot`) instead of running the candidate/context queries twice (4 full `list_issues` reads per report). The new core projection pushes status/type/tier filtering and parent-link resolution into the read model and returns only the 9 fields the reducer consumes — no descriptions, designs, notes, refs, links, or plus-one evidence.

**Measured on `gh_sase-org__sase` (8,632 issues, fresh read model):** before, 2,824 full `Issue` hydrations per report (including all 1,140 plans to find ~0 context rows, 715k description chars) at 2.95s; after, 260 candidate/context slim rows with zero heavy payload, snapshot in 0.03s, report in 2.36s. Binding/fallback parity asserted on the live store. The old whole-store parse was already gone on warm stores.

**Files:** core — `bead/read.rs`, `bead/read_model/queries.rs`, `bead/mod.rs`, `bead/read_model/mod.rs`, `sase_core_py/.../beads/mod.rs` + `tests.rs`; sase — [stranded_facts.py](/home/bryan/.local/state/sase/workspaces/sase-org/sase/sase_27/src/sase/bead/stranded_facts.py), [stranded.py](/home/bryan/.local/state/sase/workspaces/sase-org/sase/sase_27/src/sase/bead/stranded.py), [bead_read_facade.py](/home/bryan/.local/state/sase/workspaces/sase-org/sase/sase_27/src/sase/core/bead_read_facade.py), updated collector test helper, two new test files.

**Verification:** core `sase tool run check` passed; sase `just check` passed all lints plus 61,860 scoped tests with one exception — `test_pre_expand_parallel_no_embedded_workflows`, which fails identically on the clean base (verified via stash), recorded as a `PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP`, unrelated to this phase.

**Landing note for the host:** both repos changed — linked `sase-core` (new `bead_stranded_snapshot` binding) and this checkout. The host should commit core first, write the resulting SHA into `sase-core-revision.txt`, then commit sase; I left the pin file untouched.

Declaration accepted — host will commit both repositories and close the bead.
